# Stockholm School of Economics (SSE)

> > Leading European business school offering MBA, BSc, MSc, PhD, and executive education programs with a focus on research excellence and the FREE educational philosophy.

Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) is a top-ranked private business school in Sweden, accredited by EQUIS and ranked by Financial Times. The institution emphasizes its FREE philosophy (empowerment, empathy, entrepreneurship) and maintains research centers including SITE, MISUM, and the Center for Retailing, with partnerships through the CIVICA European University alliance.
